english.meaning: to be apart by a distance or a stretch of time; to leave a gap
english.note: 隔到好耐 means after a long gap.

exampleSentences.english: Is it because of you that it takes so long every time?
exampleSentences.traditional: 因為你，次次都隔到好耐嗎。
